```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(socviz)
library(scales)

# Load election data
election_panel <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/election_panel_2000_2024.csv"
)

# Load county geometries
counties <- socviz::county_map 

# Join election data to map
map_data <- counties |>
  left_join(election_panel, by = c("id" = "id"))

# Plot
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_polygon(aes(x= long, y = lat,
                   fill = pct_DEMOCRAT), color = NA) +
  
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +
  
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#FFFFFF", "grey80", "#81ABD9", "#211f82"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 1)),
    name = "Percent Democrat",
    labels = percent_format(scale = 1)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Presidential Elections, 2000–2024",
    subtitle = "Votes toward Democratic Presidential Candidates"
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#6C8EBF", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
    
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(viridis)
library(scales)

# Get income data
ny_income <- read_csv("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/NY_pinc_wide.csv")

# Get NY county geometries
ny_counties_sf <- counties(state = "NY", year = 2024, cb = TRUE) |>
  st_as_sf()

# Convert wide -> long format
ny_income_long <- ny_income |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("pincp"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "income"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(str_remove(year, "pincp"))
  )

# Keep only 2019–2024
ny_recent <- ny_income_long |>
  filter(year >= 2019)

# Join data to map
map_data <- ny_counties_sf |>
  mutate(fips = as.numeric(GEOID)) |>
  left_join(ny_recent, by = "fips")

# Titles
p_title <- "Personal Income by County in New York"
p_caption <- "Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (https://www.bea.gov/data/income-saving/personal-income-by-county)"

# Plot
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = income), color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    trans = "log10",
    name = "Income\n(log-10 scale)",
    labels = dollar_format()
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = p_title,
    caption = p_caption
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
